authoritySelection: independently commissioned and anchored before worker invocation

stateSchema.message: nonempty UTF-8 string of at most 128 bytes; no other keys

product.canonicalEncoding: UTF-8 JSON.stringify({message:value}) followed by one LF
product.show: node message.mjs show prints the validated message followed by one LF, exits zero, and preserves the state file
product.set: node message.mjs set <value> validates the existing record and the sole supplied value, atomically replaces the canonical record and exits zero with no stdout
product.invalid: missing/extra arguments, unknown command, empty value, value over 128 UTF-8 bytes, missing/corrupt/extra-key state all exit nonzero with a diagnostic and preserve any existing state bytes
product.build: validate default state and copy CLI plus canonical default data into an absent dist root; execute dist/message.mjs from outside the source checkout

requirements.outcome: exact runtime/frozen dependencies and all declared static/regression checks pass
real clean build and external built CLI use succeed; an omitted CLI or invalid default fails
show prints the exact declared default/current value and newline without modifying state
valid single-byte and multibyte values including the 128-byte boundary publish canonical JSON atomically
every declared invalid case including 129-byte input rejects and preserves existing bytes
a new process observes the exact last accepted value; interrupted replacement leaves exact old or new valid bytes
every successful child owns a validated receipt bound to exact authority/candidate/runtime and actual artifacts
